nights.title: Maustetytöt - Itken Jos Mua Huvittaa European Tour 26
nights.name: Maustetytöt
nights.extract: Maustetytöt is a Finnish girl group consisting of sisters Anna Karjalainen and Kaisa Karjalainen. The band's trademarks include a laconic and serious-looking performance style.

en.who: Maustetytöt is a Finnish girl group. its members are the sisters Anna Karjalainen and Kaisa Karjalainen.
facts: Maustetytöt is a Finnish girl group consisting of sisters Anna Karjalainen and Kaisa Karjalainen.
The band's trademarks include a laconic and serious-looking performance style.

zu den markenzeichen der band gehört ein lakonischer und ernst wirkender auftritt.

tr.who: Maustetytöt, Anna Karjalainen ve Kaisa Karjalainen kardeşlerden oluşan bir Fin kız grubudur. grup ağırbaşlı, ciddi görünümlü sahne tarzıyla bilinir.
